maddeler.e:
ألتمس (form VIII)
# أَلْتَمِسُ (ʔaltamisu) /ʔal.ta.mi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# أُلْتَمَسُ (ʔultamasu) /ʔul.ta.ma.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# أَلْتَمِسَ (ʔaltamisa) /ʔal.ta.mi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# أُلْتَمَسَ (ʔultamasa) /ʔul.ta.ma
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
